claims.claim: The answer must contain a general or specific denial of the material allegations the defendant controverts.
claims.quote:
(b) The answer to a complaint shall contain:
(1) The general or specific denial of the material allegations of the complaint controverted by the defendant.

claims.claim: The answer must state any new matter constituting a defense.
claims.quote:
(b) The answer to a complaint shall contain:
(1) The general or specific denial of the material allegations of the complaint controverted by the defendant.
(2) A statement of any new matter constituting a defense.
The defenses shall be separately stated

claims.claim: The defenses must refer to the causes of action they answer in a way that intelligibly distinguishes them.
claims.quote: the several defenses shall refer to the causes of action which they are intended to answer, in a manner by which they may be intelligibly distinguished.

claims.claim: Subject to the verified collection-assignment exception stated in the draft, a general denial suffices if the complaint is subject to the specified Article 2 or is not verified.
claims.quote: If the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1 or is not verified, a general denial is sufficient

claims.claim: A general denial puts only the complaint's material allegations in issue.
claims.quote: a general denial is sufficient but only puts in issue the material allegations of the complaint.

claims.claim: For a verified complaint outside that Article 2, denials must be made positively or according to the defendant's information and belief.
claims.quote: If the complaint is verified, unless the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1, the denial of the allegations shall be made positively or according to the information and belief of the defendant.

claims.claim: For a claim assigned to a third party for collection, if the complaint is verified, the same denial requirement applies even under that Article 2.
claims.quote: However, if the cause of action is a claim assigned to a third party for collection and the complaint is verified, the denial of the allegations shall be made positively or according to the information and belief of the defendant, even if the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1.

claims.claim: The time limit for an action on a contract, obligation or liability founded upon a written instrument is four years, except as provided in Section 336a.
claims.quote:
Within four years:
(a) An action upon any contract, obligation or liability founded upon an instrument in writing, except as provided in Section 336a;
claims.note: The post-sale balance rule is outside the stated unsecured-contract scope.

claims.claim: The cited form is Judicial Council form PLD-050, revised January 1, 2024.
claims.quote: Judicial Council form PLD-050 (General Denial), Rev. January 1, 2024

claims.claim: Item 2 provides for the defendant to state facts as separate affirmative defenses to the plaintiff's complaint.
claims.quote:
2.  DEFENDANT states the following FACTS as separate affirmative defenses to plaintiff's complaint (attach additional
pages if necessary):
claims.note: The draft describes item 2 without instructing every defendant to use the form.

result.summary: The provided texts support the pleading rules, the four-year limit and its stated exception within the unsecured-contract scope, and the description of PLD-050 item 2.
